newsitem.title: USA: C-TEC directors to be paid in stock.
newsitem.headline: C-TEC directors to be paid in stock.

text.p: C-TEC Corp said its board of directors eliminated cash payments to its members and approved a stock-based compensation plan.
The new plan is designed to encourage board members, who are not C-TEC employees, to have a personal financial stake in C-TEC and further align the board's interests with shareholders, C-TEC said.

The total number of shares granted will be calculated by dividing the fees ($10,800 annual retainer/$1,000 per meeting) by the average of the daily closing price of a share of common stock on the grant date, C-TEC said.
The plan also specifies that non-management directors are required to hold shares for a minimum of six months from the date of grant, the company said.
